title.en: I know that you know that I know

hint.zh: 诸葛亮赌的是司马懿「多想一层」
hint.en: Zhuge Liang bets that Sima Yi will think one level too far

hint.zh: 曹操多想了一层，正好踩进诸葛亮多想两层挖的坑
hint.en: Cao Cao thinks one level further, straight into a trap dug two levels deep

title.zh: 福尔摩斯在坎特伯雷下车

hint.zh: 冯·诺依曼拿它当教材：最优解是掷骰子
hint.en: Von Neumann used it as a textbook case: the best answer is to roll dice

title.en: The schoolboy who guessed odd or even

hint.zh: 文学里最早的「你想到第几层」
hint.en: The earliest “how many levels deep do you think” in literature

title.en: A battle of wits over two cups

hint.zh: 「所以我绝不能喝你面前那杯」——可以一直推下去
hint.en: “So I clearly cannot choose the wine in front of you” — and so on without end

hint.zh: 她说的是「不」，他听到的是「再求一次」
hint.en: She says no; he hears “ask again”

hint.zh: 私心越大，话越不值钱
hint.en: The larger the bias, the less the words are worth

title.en: Zou Ji asks who is fairer

hint.zh: 夸你的人各有各的理由，唯独不是因为你美
hint.en: Everyone who praises you has a reason, and it is never your looks

hint.zh: 两个人都为对方多想了一层，于是恰好错开
hint.en: Each thinks one level further for the other, and so they miss

hint.zh: 不是选你觉得最美的，是选大家觉得大家会选的
hint.en: Pick not the prettiest, but what everyone thinks everyone will pick

hint.zh: 两个互相提防的人，各写一字，摊开手一模一样
hint.en: Two wary allies each write one word; they open their hands to the same one

hint.zh: 没法商量时，两个人会不约而同想到同一个地方
hint.en: With no way to confer, two people still think of the same place

hint.zh: 通篇都是好话，读完却知道这人不行
hint.en: Nothing but praise, and yet you finish it knowing he will not do

hint.zh: 猜得太准，是要掉脑袋的
hint.en: Guess too well and it costs you your head

hint.zh: 没说出口的那半句，是听的人自己推出来的
hint.en: The half left unsaid is worked out by the listener

hint.zh: 话说得越含糊，越安全
hint.en: The vaguer the words, the safer

hint.zh: 读本 · 满座都在打暗号，只有该看懂的那个人不接
hint.en: Reader · The whole table is trading signals; the one man meant to read them will not

hint.zh: 读本 · 骂的是丫头，说给宝玉听，宝钗也听得懂
hint.en: Reader · She scolds the maid, means it for Baoyu, and Baochai understands too

hint.zh: 读本 · 让对方以为是他自己偷到的，他才会深信不疑
hint.en: Reader · Let him think he stole it himself, and he will never doubt it

hint.zh: 读本 · 先让你相信「我看得出你有病」，再让你自己走瘸
hint.en: Reader · First you believe he can see you are ill; then you limp on your own

title.zh: 「大臣，这是个很有勇气的决定」

hint.zh: 读本 · 公务员的夸奖要查字典：勇气 = 丢选票
hint.en: Reader · A civil servant's praise needs a dictionary: courageous means losing the election

title.zh: 他们不知道我们知道他们知道
title.en: They don't know that we know they know

hint.zh: 读本 · 情景喜剧史上嵌套最深的一句台词
hint.en: Reader · The most deeply nested line in sitcom history

title.en: The debate on the bridge over the Hao

hint.zh: 读本 · 两千三百年前，就有人追问「你怎么知道我不知道」
hint.en: Reader · 2,300 years ago someone already asked: how do you know that I don't know?

hint.zh: 读本 · 确认了一万次，仍然不敢动手
hint.en: Reader · Ten thousand confirmations, and still neither dares to move

hint.zh: 读本 · 一句人人早就知道的话，为什么还能改变一切
hint.en: Reader · Why a sentence everyone already knew can still change everything
